query:
SELECT f.id, f.sha256
           FROM files f
           WHERE f.org_id = $1
             AND COALESCE(f.unreferenced_since, f.created_at)
                 <= timestamptz 'epoch' + $2::bigint * interval '1 microsecond'
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM course_files cf WHERE cf.org_id = f.org_id AND cf.file_id = f.id)
           ORDER BY f.id
           LIMIT $3
